scope: Linux operating-system display-brightness candidate: active local-session logind delegation, shared typed transactions and conditional recovery, CLI raw expected-current guard and GUI unknown-state gating. Offline verification is separate from installed release, requested-state runtime readback and physical luminance acceptance.

source.snapshot_scope: 59 production/test inputs verified unchanged during the final suite and isolated behavior regressions; feature source now has a fixed signed local commit. No new installed release is claimed.
source.source_commit_signature: git verification G; fixed local source commit, not evidence of remote publication or installation

implemented.linux_write_routes: Retain direct sysfs writes when permitted; otherwise validate the fixed system logind service, effective UID, active local primary session, foreground seat and canonical backlight binding before delegated writes. Preview eligibility does not guarantee later authorization.
implemented.permissions: Normal-user logind delegation does not chmod sysfs, start a custom root helper or run the full GUI as root. Device/session/seat and original raw value are revalidated before a setter.
implemented.readback_scope: Requested brightness and actual_brightness are separately retained; OS requested-state readback is not a measurement of emitted luminance.
implemented.transaction: Typed confirmed/not_applied/conflict/restored/recovery_failed/unknown outcomes retain primary, rollback and readback errors separately. Direct conditional recovery does not overwrite an observed third-party value. A lost delegated reply or writer that may continue remains unknown and does not trigger speculative rollback.
implemented.cli: --expected-current accepts a raw unsigned brightness value and binds the observed original plan, not a percentage. A mismatch rejects before apply; core and setter recheck the same original baseline. Failed or unknown operations are not automatically retried.
implemented.gui: Unknown brightness state blocks new brightness preview/application until an explicit valid reconciliation. If the returned transaction says a remote writer may continue, this process keeps its brightness write gate latched, including after explicit observation. Closing waits only for actual local in-flight work and worker exit; once that local work returns, remote writer uncertainty alone does not prevent close. Closing does not retry or restore brightness. Other pending-control previews keep their established invalidation and refusal contracts.
implemented.windows: Existing WMI brightness and shared transaction code compile for the Windows target; no Windows runtime or hardware qualification is established.

rust.count_scope: One whole workspace suite, not brightness-only or per-family counts. Windows is a compile check only.

python_console.scope: One offline console-domain suite; no hardware acceptance.

python_power_domain.scope: Historical CPU round only; power-domain source was not changed. Not counted as a new brightness verification run.

isolated_production_regressions.scope: Three exact Fake BrightnessIo tests in an isolated clone; each baseline ran one passing test, each mutated production implementation recompiled and produced one actual behavioral assertion failure. These are not schema/missing-fixture panics, full-suite reruns or hardware tests.

native_gui_runtime.scope: GUI worker, transaction and layout contracts are offline tests; no new native GUI brightness action is accepted.

gui_close_boundary.scope: Included in the final passing offline workspace suite. Remote-writer uncertainty keeps new brightness writes blocked; after actual local worker completion the controller can close, without automatic retry or restoration. Not native graceful-close/runtime evidence.

earlier_failures_retained.scope: Earlier GUI syntax, cross-control invalidation semantics and collapsed-content assertions failed in private attempts. Their receipts remain separate; final green results do not erase these failures.

deployment.latest_recorded_installed_release_scope: Historical r168 console and power18 installation; does not contain this new brightness candidate.

source.scope: Ready selected-source watcher still running at documentation. Counts are session cumulative/retained and are not a finalized tracking receipt; parent owns finalization.

untracked_backup_bytecode.cause: Root validation omitted Python -B; incidental bytecode was created inside an older backup directory.
untracked_backup_bytecode.record_basis: Root-reported accidental output and independent preservation check; no complete creation history is claimed.

isolated_regressions.scope: Command success and partial transient-fixture tracking remain separate; production/source and log hashes are independently retained.
